task_objective: Publish durable audit verdicts in the tracked repository so fresh Cloudflare builds enforce the catalog gate, while avoiding unchanged-state commits.

setup.remote_dev_pull: Attempted git pull --ff-only origin dev and recorded the failure at /tmp/decky-plugins-extended/pull-dev-error.log; origin has no dev ref, so the clean local dev tip 42c3526 was used as the required base.
setup.plan_history: The plan was already committed in dev ancestry as c2b968d, so feat/verdict-publication inherited the required plan commit instead of creating a duplicate empty commit.
setup.tooling: The repository has no run.sh. XDG_CACHE_HOME was isolated under /tmp/decky-plugins-extended/uv-cache because the sandboxed global uv cache was read-only.

implementation.tracked_store: audit_plugins.load_verdicts reads repository-root security-verdicts.json first and falls back to .audit-cache/verdicts.json only when the tracked file is absent. Verdict writes atomically replace the tracked file; report cache files remain under the still-gitignored .audit-cache directory.
implementation.determinism: The atomic writer emits recursively sorted, two-space-indented JSON with a trailing newline. A verdict whose classification, blocking rule IDs, and artifact hash are unchanged preserves the entire existing record, including audited_at, so repeated audits produce identical bytes.
implementation.scheduled_publication: The scheduled audit job has job-scoped contents: write permission, snapshots the prior tracked store, exits when git diff --quiet finds no change, stages only security-verdicts.json, includes the number of changed verdict records in the bot-authored commit message, rebases before pushing, and rebases plus retries one time if the first push races.
implementation.production_shape: The catalog regression test runs generate_json.main from a fresh-clone-shaped temporary root containing security-verdicts.json and no .audit-cache directory. It verifies the blocked normalized version and artifact hash are absent from both catalogs and the fallback release is first.
implementation.test_isolation: A suite-wide autouse fixture redirects tracked verdict writes into each test's temporary directory. The full suite now proves security-verdicts.json remains byte-unchanged after all auditor tests run.

verification_evidence.pre_fix_reproduction: The fresh-clone test failed 1 test before implementation. Its catalog contained both ('2.0.0', bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb) and the fallback ('1.0.0', aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa), proving the BLOCK verdict was ignored.
verification_evidence.tracked_load_without_cache: 1 passed; the test creates and then removes .audit-cache before loading the tracked store.
verification_evidence.determinism_and_change: 1 passed; a later audit timestamp and context hash with the same classification, rule IDs, and artifact hash produced byte-identical output and preserved the old audited_at, while a classification change changed the bytes and timestamp.
verification_evidence.workflow_diff_probe: 1 passed; git diff --quiet -- security-verdicts.json returned 0 for unchanged tracked bytes and 1 after a verdict change.
verification_evidence.fresh_clone_negative_control: 1 passed, run last after the failure-case checks; the blocked version and hash were absent from plugins.json and testing_plugins.json, and the fallback release was versions[0].
verification_evidence.workflow_targeted: 9 passed; an additional executable YAML inspection reported 7 workflow behavior checks passed.
verification_evidence.quality_gates: ruff check passed; 30 files already formatted; 231 passed and 21 subtests passed; no deleted review notes; security-verdicts.json remained unchanged during the full suite.

test_adjustment_rationale: No existing expected behavior was weakened. Existing audit-verdict tests now isolate the tracked verdict path so their cache directories remain independent.
not_verified: The GitHub Actions push/rebase path was structurally and locally tested but was not executed against GitHub, because the plan forbids pushing.
A live Cloudflare Pages build was not triggered; the production-shaped generator test exercises the same fresh-clone file availability boundary locally.
